title: Totality convention: udiv0
statement: For every 8-bit word x, bvudiv x 0 = 0xFF. SMT-LIB makes unsigned division total by this convention; it is a theorem of the definition, not a choice a solver may make.
scope: width 8; the SMT-LIB 2.6 semantics of the operator

evidence.note: The negated statement is asserted; axeyum front door (smtcomp_cli) returns unsat. Verdict-level evidence: the front door checks its own unsat internally (term-level/Alethe) but this CLI does not export the certificate. Exported-certificate form is an open exercise (see axeyum-guide/02-equivalence.md).

sources: CLAUDE.md Hard Rules: a946f925 shipped a wrong-unsat when div-by-constant-zero was folded to a fixed convention
